...

...         sleep(2)
...         caput('XF:11IDB-BI{XBPM:02}Fdbk:AEn-SP',0)
...         caput('XF:11IDB-BI{XBPM:02}Fdbk:BEn-SP',1)
...         series(det='eiger1m',expt=1,imnum=500,acqp='auto',comment=description, analysis='',auto_compression=True, feedback_on=False)

...              # this sets att2.set_T(0)
...         caput('XF:11IDB-ES{Det:Eig1M}cam1:NumImages',1)
...         RE.md.pop('thh_value') 
...         caput('XF:11IDA-OP{Mir:HDM-Ax:P}Sts:FB-Sel',1)
...

>>> def XPCS(expt=5,imnum=2340, transmission=1, comment = 'XPCS scan'):
...     current_transmission=att2.get_T()
...     att2.set_T(transmission)
...     RE.md['phi_v']=round(caget('XF:11IDB-ES{Dif-Ax:ThV}Mtr.RBV'),4)  
...     RE.md['del']=round(caget('XF:11IDB-ES{Dif-Ax:Del}Mtr.RBV'),4)
...     RE.md['gam']=round(caget('XF:11IDB-ES{Dif-Ax:Gam}Mtr.RBV'),4)   
...     
...     series(det='eiger1m',expt=expt,imnum=imnum,feedback_on=True,
...             auto_compression=True,comment=comment + ' AUTO_COMMENT')
... 
...     caput('XF:11IDA-OP{Mir:HDM-Ax:P}Sts:FB-Sel',1)
...     att2.set_T(current_transmission) # setting back the transmission to initial value
...     RE.md.pop('phi_v')
...     RE.md.pop('del')
...     RE.md.pop('gam')
...     caput('XF:11IDB-ES{Det:Eig1M}cam1:NumImages',1)
...     caput('XF:11IDB-ES{Det:Eig1M}cam1:AcquirePeriod',1)
...     caput('XF:11IDB-ES{Det:Eig1M}cam1:AcquireTime',1)

>>> def XPCSseries(expt=1,imnum=1800, transmission=1, comment=''):
...     att2.set_T(transmission)  #empty slot in the beam
...     series(det='eiger1m',expt=expt,imnum=imnum,feedback_on=True, auto_compression=True,comment='AUTO_COMMENT')
... 
...     caput('XF:11IDB-ES{Det:Eig1M}cam1:NumImages',1)
...     caput('XF:11IDA-OP{Mir:HDM-Ax:P}Sts:FB-Sel',1)
...    
... 
...     
... def temperature_series(Temperatures=[30,90,110,130,150,180], wait_time=3600):
...     for temp in Temperatures:
...         set_temperature(temp)
...         RE(sleep(wait_time))
...         XPCSseries()
...

>>> def redis_mapping_to_nested_dict(redis_conn, key, separator=':'):
...     """
...     Converts a Redis mapping with a hierarchical key structure to a nested dictionary.
... 
...     Args:
...         redis_conn: Redis connection object.
...         key: The base key of the mapping.
...         separator: Separator used in the Redis keys to denote hierarchy.
... 
...     Returns:
...         A nested dictionary representing the Redis mapping.
...     """
...     data = {}
...     for name, value in redis_conn.hscan_iter(key):
...         parts = name.decode('utf-8').split(separator)
...         current_level = data
...         for i, part in enumerate(parts):
...             if i == len(parts) - 1:
...                 current_level[part] = value.decode('utf-8')
...             else:
...                 if part not in current_level:
...                     current_level[part] = {}
...                 current_level = current_level[part]
...     return data
...

...         if np.max(error)<=tolerance or trig:
...             break
...     return np.array(x),np.sqrt(y)

>>> def get_Bragg_temp(reflection, E=8.0):
...     """
...     by LW 17/03/2010
...     function return the Bragg angle [deg.] of a given material and reflection at a given Energy.
...     Calling sequence: thetaB=get_Bragg(reflection,E),  thetaB(1)=Bragg angle[deg.] thetaB(2)=dhkl [A], thetaB(3)=I/Io [%].
...     E: x-ray energy in keV (can be an array of energies),
...     reflection: string, e.g. 'Si111'. Reflections implemented from http://database.iem.ac.ru/mincryst, T=25C or calculated from XOP, e.g for Si111&Si220 @80Kget_Bragg(\'reflections?\') for a list of currently available materials;
...     """
...     reflstr = [
...         "Si111cryo",
...         "Si220cryo",
...         "Si111",
...         "Si220",
...         "Si113",
...         "Si224",
...         "Si331",
...         "Si400",
...         "Ge111",
...         "Ge220",
...         "Ge113",
...         "Ge224",
...         "Ge331",
...         "Ge620",
...         "Ge531",
...         "Ge400",
...         "Ge115",
...         "Ge335",
...         "Ge440",
...         "Ge444",
...         "Ge333",
...         "C111",
...         "C220",
...     ]
... 
... 
... 
... 
...     dspace = np.array(
...         [
...             3.13379852,
...             1.91905183,
...             3.13542,
...             1.92004,
...             1.63742,
...             1.10854,
...             1.24589,
...             1.35767,
...             3.26627,
...             2.00018,
...             1.70576,
...             1.15480,
...             1.29789,
...             0.89451,
...             0.95627,
...             1.41434,
...             1.08876,
...             0.86274,
...             40.50,
...             23.80,
...             16.60,
...             10.90,
...             100,
...             73.80,
...             44.10,
...             23.10,
...             17.00,
...             15.90,
...             15.70,
...             11.50,
...             9.80,
...             8.50,
...             8.20,
...             7.30,
...             3.30,
...             100,
...             39.00,
...         ]
...     )
... 
...     if isinstance(
...         reflection, str
...     ):  # and all(isinstance(E, (int, long, float, complex)) for item in [E,E]): # <- bug in python: check for E is numeric works in standalone function, but not in this package => don't check
...         E = np.array(E)
...         lam = get_Lambda(E, "A")
...         if reflection in reflstr:
...             ind = reflstr.index(reflection)
...             print(
...                 reflstr[ind]
...                 + ": d_{hkl}="
...                 + "%3.4f" % dspace[ind]
...                 + "A   I/I_o="
...                 + "%3.4f" % Irel[ind]
...             )
...             theta = np.degrees(np.arcsin(lam / 2 / dspace[ind]))
...             ds = []
...             I_list = []
...             for _ in range(0, np.size(theta)):
...                 ds.append(dspace[ind])
...                 I_list.append(Irel[ind])
...             res = list([np.array([theta]), np.array(ds), np.array(I_list)])[0]
...             return res.T
...         elif reflection == "reflections?":
...             print("List of available reflections (T=25C):")
...             print(reflstr)
...         else:
...             print(
...                 'error: reflection not found. Type get_Bragg("reflections?") for list of available reflections.'
...             )
...     else:
...         print(
...             "error: reflection has to be a string and E needs to be numeric. Type get_Bragg? for help"
...         )
...
